Install perplexity on Omarchy

The official desktop client for Perplexity, an AI answer engine that searches the web and returns a synthesized, source-cited response rather than just a list of results. The desktop app adds OS-level conveniences such as screenshot-to-search and quick access to chat and research directly from your desktop, on top of Perplexity's usual free and paid web features.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add perplexity
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 26.10.2+build117519-1:
    pacman -Qi perplexity

Open and use perplexity

perplexity is a desktop app. Press Super + Space to open the launcher and search for it. If it does not show up by name, list the desktop entries the package installed:

pacman -Ql perplexity | grep applications

perplexity requirements and compatibility

  • A Perplexity account (free or paid)
  • Network access
  • A paid subscription for advanced models, higher limits, and some premium features

Frequently asked questions

How do I install perplexity on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add perplexity. The download is 189.6 MB and it takes 759 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is perplexity free?

Free plan available; Pro $20/mo, Max $50/mo, Enterprise $40/user/mo for advanced models and features. The package is licensed custom.

How do I uninstall perplexity?

Run omarchy pkg drop perplexity. It removes the package from your system.

What does perplexity depend on?

The package declares 36 dependencies: alsa-lib, at-spi2-core, bash, bubblewrap, cairo, dbus, expat, gcc-libs, gdk-pixbuf2, glib2, glibc, gtk3 and more. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is perplexity a desktop app?

Yes. Open the launcher with Super + Space and search for perplexity.

Is perplexity in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as perplexity (version 26.10.2+build117519-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Perplexity makes it. Project site: https://www.perplexity.ai. This site is unofficial and not affiliated with Omarchy or Omacom.
